items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We were able to convince Maya Angelou to – it didn’t take much. She would allow us to put music to one of her poems.

ctx.x: Also on Turned to Blue is the title track. Tell us about that.

We were able to convince Maya Angelou to – it didn’t take much. She would allow us to put music to one of her poems. Of course she said yes, and we were down to about – we had three choices, and Turned to Blue was the one that made the most sense. But we went through – collected and went through most of her things, and that was the one we wanted to put to music.
